capture_method: Actual route modules through the deterministic local-only evidence server. Each requested browser viewport was held for three stable layout samples. Browser-visible frames matched the requested dimensions exactly and were converted from the browser JPEG transport to real PNG files without scaling before hashing. Loaded and lifecycle states permit only fixture reads; error states intentionally return deterministic read failures. No external service or mutation is available.
